business_summary: Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of high-purity silver and silver deep-processing products in China and internationally. The company offers high-purity silver and silver products, high-purity silver nitrate, electrolytic lead, gold, lead concentrate, zinc concentrate, and sulfur concentrate. It is also involved in the mining, beneficiation, smelting, and trading of ferrous and non-ferrous metals. The company was formerly known as Chenzhou City Jingui Silver Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd. in April 2024. Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Chenzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 고순도 은 및 은 심가공 제품의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 고순도 은 및 은제품, 고순도 질산은, 전해납, 금, 납정광, 아연정광, 유황정광을 공급하고 있습니다. 또한 철 및 비철금속의 채굴, 선광, 제련 및 거래에도 관여합니다. 회사는 이전에 Chenzhou City Jingui Silver Industry Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 이름을 Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd로 변경했습니다. 2024년 4월. Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd. 2004년에 설립되었으며 중국 천저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
